title: Tailnet Home
_comment: Copy to services.json (git-ignored) and edit. `device` is the MagicDNS short name. Give a full `url`, or just `port`/`path`/`scheme` and scan.py builds the address from the device's Tailscale IP (MagicDNS name for https). `lang`: "en" or "zh"; empty follows the browser.
_comment_hide: URLs found by `tailscale serve` or --probe that you don't want listed.
_comment_bookmarks: Links outside the tailnet, shown in their own section.
